nodes.label: HPLCameraBridge
nodes.rationale: Intercepts and modifies HPL3 camera frustums to inject HMD poses.

nodes.label: HPLPlayerState
nodes.rationale: Tracks native player states (e.g., Sit, Climb, Death) to apply comfort policies.

nodes.label: HPLInputBridge
nodes.rationale: Maps OpenXR actions to native HPL3 input routes like iCharacterBody::Move.
